summary: Lets a Lunar grow moonsilver-reinforced dragon scales for a scene, granting a large soak bonus like articulated plate armor; incompatible with worn armor but stackable with Hide-Toughening Essence, Armor-Forming Technique, and a carried shield.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Armor-Forming Technique.
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar can transform his hide to resemble that of a ferocious Celestial dragon. His body is covered with overlapping moonsilver-reinforced scales that glisten coldly in the light and provide formidable protection against all forms of attack. It is as if the character is swathed in articulated plate armor, and the Lunar gains a +9L/+9B soak bonus, while incurring only a -1 mobility penalty. The armor has no fatigue value, and it is not counted as armor for the purposes of attacks that ignore armor, but it does count as armor for the purposes of stopping aggravated attacks. Unlike the other armor-enhancing Charms known to the Lunar Exalted, Scales of the Dragon is not compatible with the use of armor. However, the character's player continues to count her character's Stamina (or half Stamina against lethal damage) as she gains the benefits of a shield; the Lunar still gains the benefits of a shield if carried, and can reinforce her defense with Hide-Toughening Essence and Armor-Forming Technique. No combination of this Charm, those two Charms, and the effects of Deadly Beastman Transformation can increase either of the character's natural soaks above 12. If the character's soak would rise above 12, then the character will ignore attacks that have raw damage less than the difference between 12 and what the Lunar's soak should be, to a maximum of 12.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Invulnerable Moonsilver Carapace
summary: Capstone of the Defensive III tree; floods the Lunar's body in a fluid moonsilver carapace, adding a huge, perfect soak bonus for the turn at a crippling Essence cost and a Dexterity/Perception penalty.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 5; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Limb-Shielding Growth, Scales of the Dragon.
mechanics: By activating this Charm, the Lunar shields herself in a carapace of moonsilver, which appears to flow out of her pores to completely cover her body in shimmering plates. There are no gaps or weak points in this armor, which glistens fluidly as the Lunar moves. Though appearing to be liquid, the Invulnerable Moonsilver Carapace is invulnerable to any form of attack. It adds 15B/15L to the Lunar's soak until the end of the turn. This soak stacks with armor and cannot be circumvented by any stratagem, Charm or sorcery (this is a perfect effect) and is not armor for the purposes of Charms that do not work with armor. Its Essence cost is, however, crippling. During turns when the Invulnerable Moonsilver Carapace is activated, the Lunar suffers a -3 penalty to her Dexterity and Perception, though these cannot reduce the Attributes below 1.
compatibility: Duration: One turn. Type: Reflexive.

name: Beast Instinct Method
summary: Root of the Survival and Healing I/II trees; lets a Lunar purchase bonus dice on Survival rolls up to his unmodified Wits.
requirements: Minimum Wits 2; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: None.
mechanics: A Lunar's ties to the wild allow him to survive in conditions where others would suffer great hardship. By using this Charm, the Lunar taps into his bestial nature, using instinct and cunning rather than rational thought to guide his actions. When attempting any form of Survival roll that involves Wits, the Lunar's player may purchase additional dice up to his character's unmodified Wits score.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Supplemental.

name: Whale-Breath Technique
summary: Lets a Lunar hold his breath for Stamina x 10 minutes and survive underwater, in poison gas, or where there is no air at all, though he cannot speak while it is active.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Beast Instinct Method.
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar replicates the breath control of a diving whale and need not breathe for a considerable period of time (Stamina x 10 minutes). The Lunar can survive underwater, in poison gas, or where there's no air at all. However, the Lunar cannot speak without compromising the Charm -- doing so requires him to expel air from his lungs. The Lunar may speak a few words, perhaps a short sentence, but if he does so, the duration of the Charm decreases to one minute. If he speaks again, the duration decreases to five turns. A third attempt at speech or any form of longer communication cancels the Charm. As part of activating the Charm, the Lunar must take a deep breath and so cannot simply reactivate it in hostile conditions.
compatibility: Duration: Stamina x 10 minutes. Type: Simple.

name: Gill-Breathing Technique
summary: Lets a Lunar grow gills so he can breathe underwater as well as in air for the rest of the day; can be re-triggered for 5 motes to keep the gills indefinitely.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Whale-Breath Technique.
mechanics: By activating this Charm, the Lunar manipulates his body to form gills. This allows him to breathe as well in water as in air for the rest of the day. A character existing underwater may simply commit 5 motes to keep gills indefinitely.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Reflexive.

name: Sealskin Endurance
summary: Lets a Lunar grow a protective layer (blubber, thick fur, etc.) that lets him exist in relative comfort in the coldest conditions, immune to hypothermia, frostbite, immersion, and snow blindness.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Beast Instinct Method.
mechanics: By activating this Charm, the Lunar protects himself from cold conditions. The exact method differs from Lunar to Lunar -- some may grow a layer of blubber, others a pelt of warm fur -- but the effects are the same. For the duration of the Charm, the Lunar can exist in relative comfort even in the coldest conditions. He does not suffer from hypothermia, frostbite or immersion, nor does he suffer the effects of snow blindness. He is not, however, protected from the harshest rigors of the Elemental Poles, nor from magically conjured cold.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple.
notes: Charm's header and stat block are at the bottom of PDF page 171 (printed p. 168); the mechanics text continues onto PDF page 172 (printed p. 169). Transcribed as a single continuous Charm.

name: Heat Adapting Method
summary: The opposite of Sealskin Endurance; makes the Lunar's body lean and efficient for warm environments, immune to heatstroke, sand blindness, blistering and sunburn.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Beast Instinct Method.
mechanics: This Charm has the opposite effect of Sealskin Endurance, resulting in a lean, sleek Lunar adapted to the rigors of warm environments. His body becomes highly efficient at conserving water and adept at radiating excess heat without the need for sweating. For the duration of the Charm, the Lunar can exist in relative comfort in even the warmest conditions. He does not suffer heatstroke or sand blindness, nor does his skin blister and burn after exposure to the sun. The Heat Adapting Method does not protect the Lunar from the effects of fire.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple.

name: Fire-Walking Prana
summary: Lets a Lunar walk through flames and across burning coals without suffering ill effects for a short time, adding his Essence to his soak against magical fire and resisting smoke inhalation and overheating.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Heat Adapting Method.
mechanics: By means of this Charm, the Lunar can -- for a short time -- resist the effects of fire. He may walk through flames and across burning coals without suffering ill effects. He is not, however, immune to the effects of prolonged heat. The character adds his Essence to his soak against magical fire. While under the protection of this Charm, the character is also immune to the effects of smoke inhalation and to overheating caused by exposure to flames.
compatibility: Duration: 10 turns. Type: Simple.

name: Unerring Den-Finding Sense
summary: Lets a Lunar unerringly find shelter suited to the environment for himself and a number of associates via a Perception + Survival roll, though it only guarantees shelter, not food or firewood.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Beast Instinct Method.
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar can unerringly find shelter for himself and a number of associates. The exact sort of shelter will depend on the environment -- in rocky terrain, the Lunar's senses may lead him to a cave or cleft, while, in a forest, he may divine a hollow tree of suitable size. The Lunar's player makes a Perception + Survival roll, each success indicating capacity for one person, irrespective of the environmental conditions. However, this protection merely shields the characters from the elements -- it does not guarantee there be firewood or food in the vicinity.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.
notes: Charm's header and stat block are at the bottom of PDF page 172 (printed p. 169); the mechanics text continues onto PDF page 173 (printed p. 170). Transcribed as a single continuous Charm. It appears as a node feeding into the Survival and Healing II tree diagram, but its own Prerequisite Charms line lists only Beast Instinct Method (not Wolf Endurance Method's other inputs).

name: Food-Scenting Method
summary: Lets a Lunar never go hungry in hospitable terrain by finding food for himself and, with a Perception + Survival roll, for a number of companions equal to his successes.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Beast Instinct Method.
mechanics: By using this Charm, a Lunar will never go hungry. If he is traveling during the day in hospitable terrain, the Lunar is guaranteed to find enough nuts, berries, ants and fungi to keep him well fed. If he actively forages for food, the Lunar gathers sufficient food to feed a number of people equal to his Perception + Survival, though doing so will take approximately an hour of his time. In harsher environments, the Lunar is still able to feed himself, though the Storyteller may wish the Lunar's player to roll his character's Perception + Survival, perhaps even at an increased difficulty level, to determine how many people he can feed. In no case should the difficulty increase above 3 unless the Lunar is stranded on pack ice, in the midst of a vast loose-sand desert, or in some other wildly hostile environment.
compatibility: Duration: Varies. Type: Simple.

name: Water-Providing Technique
summary: Lets a Lunar find sufficient water for his own needs for a day, and, with a Perception + Survival roll, gather enough water for a number of other people even under harsh conditions.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Beast Instinct Method.
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar can find sufficient water to meet his needs for a day. This moisture may be from concealed springs, condensation on leaves or the pulp of vegetation. Lunars in dire straits have gathered the film of moisture from around individual grains of sand, so sensitive are their tongues. If he may gather sufficient moisture to meet the needs of a number of people (including the Lunar), though harsh conditions may require his player to roll against a difficulty depending on the circumstances, each success indicating sufficient water for a person. Finding water takes 30 minutes per person, and as with the Food-Scenting Method above, the difficulty to find water where should never rise above 3.
compatibility: Duration: Varies. Type: Simple.

name: Wolf Endurance Method
summary: Root of the Survival and Healing II tree's upper branch; lets a Lunar's body run on Essence instead of food, drink and rest for a number of weeks equal to his Stamina, at a cost of temporary Attribute loss thereafter.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Food-Scenting Method, Water-Providing Technique.
mechanics: Many wild beasts can go for days without nourishment, and the Wolf Endurance Method allows the Lunar Exalted to do likewise. On a day that the Charm is active, the Lunar does not need to eat or drink and does not suffer any hunger pangs. Unfortunately, while Essence can support the body for a short while, it is very inefficient at powering the metabolism of an Exalted. As a result, the Wolf Endurance Method can be used for a number of weeks equal to the character's Stamina. After that point, the Lunar may temporarily loose a point of Strength or Stamina for each additional week. Attribute points lost in this manner cannot be recovered until the Charm is discontinued and the character has had several square and nutritious meals.
compatibility: Duration: Until released. Type: Simple.
notes: Charm's header and stat block are at the bottom of PDF page 173 (printed p. 170); the mechanics text continues onto PDF page 174 (printed p. 171). Transcribed as a single continuous Charm.

name: Bear Sleep Technique
summary: Lets a Lunar hibernate for up to several months, needing neither food nor drink, but risking his Stamina and eventually death if woken early or deprived of shelter.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Wolf Endurance Method.
mechanics: By activating this Charm, the Lunar can place himself in a deep sleep, during which time he need not eat and drink. Instead, Essence and body fat reserves sustain the Lunar. The Lunar may place himself in this hibernation for a number of months up to his Stamina score, paying 3 motes of Essence and 1 point of temporary Stamina to maintain his body during this time. However long he sleeps, the Lunar will be ravenous upon waking. The Lunar must have a solid meal within 24 hours of waking, or else, he loses an additional point of Stamina each day until he does. The Wolf Endurance Method cannot offset this Stamina loss -- after hibernating, the Lunar is beyond mere hunger. If his Stamina declines to 0, the Lunar dies. Every day after waking during which he eats properly allows the character to recover one point of Stamina (including the one spent when activating the Charm).
compatibility: Duration: 1 month. Type: Simple.

name: Fortitude of the Aurochs
summary: Lets a Lunar work for 24 hours without worry of fatigue, ignoring fatigue from Charms, sorcery, other effects, labor, and wearing armor, though not eliminating penalties already active before it was invoked.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Wolf Endurance Method.
mechanics: Constant activity places a great strain on the body, and even Exalts become fatigued after prolonged activity. By using Fortitude of the Aurochs, a Lunar can reinvigorate his body with Essence, manipulating the muscles and blood of his body to allow him to remain active. With this Charm in use, a Lunar can work for 24 hours without worry of fatigue. He does not become fatigued as a result of Charms, sorcery or other effects. Fortitude of the Aurochs does not eliminate any penalties already in effect as a result of fatigue, nor does it negate the need for sleep, only weariness from labor. Fortitude of the Aurochs also negates the need to make fatigue rolls for wearing armor, irrespective of environmental conditions.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple.

name: Ever-Waking Method
summary: Lets a Lunar reinvigorate his limbs with Essence to go 24 hours without sleep and suffer no penalties, though the fatigue symptoms are still visible; not recommended for extended use since it costs Willpower daily and long recovery afterward.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Wolf Endurance Method.
mechanics: By using Essence to reinvigorate his limbs, a Lunar can go for 24 hours without sleep and suffer no penalties. He remains fully alert during this time and can keep acting, though the Charm does nothing to alleviate the symptoms of fatigue. The character can activate this Charm every day, but doing so for a prolonged period of time is not recommended -- after a number of days equal to the character's Stamina, Essence alone is not sufficient to reinvigorate the Lunar. Each day thereafter, he must also spend a temporary Willpower, which he cannot recover without a prolonged period of sleep. After the Charm is discontinued, the Lunar must sleep for six hours for each day he was awake.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple.
notes: Charm's header and stat block are at the bottom of PDF page 174 (printed p. 171); the mechanics text continues onto PDF page 175 (printed p. 172). Transcribed as a single continuous Charm.

name: Pain-Numbing Prana
summary: Root of the Survival and Healing III tree; lets a Lunar suppress bashing wound penalties for a number of turns equal to twice his Stamina + Endurance, though lethal/aggravated penalties and incapacitation from injury still apply.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
mechanics: By utilizing this Charm, a Lunar can suppress superficial feelings of pain for a short period of time, overriding his nervous system. The duration of this Charm is equal in turns to twice the Lunar's Stamina + Endurance, during which time he may ignore any wound penalties imposed by bashing damage. However, he still suffers the effects of lethal and aggravated damage and is still rendered unconscious if his wounds (of any type) reach incapacitated.
compatibility: Duration: Varies. Type: Reflexive.

name: Will of the Stoic Warrior
summary: Lets a Lunar ignore wound penalties from moderate to severe pain (including bashing, lethal, and severe trauma), though aggravated-damage penalties still apply and incapacitation from any wound type still knocks him out.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Pain-Numbing Prana.
mechanics: Will of the Stoic Warrior allows the Lunar to suppress moderate to severe pain, such as the result of severe trauma, allowing him to ignore the dice pool penalties imposed by bashing or lethal damage. However, he still suffers the penalties imposed by aggravated damage and is still rendered unconscious if his wounds (of any type) reach incapacitated. The effects of this Charm last for a number of turns equal to the Exalt's Stamina + Endurance.
compatibility: Duration: Varies. Type: Reflexive.
notes: Charm's header and stat block are at the bottom of PDF page 175 (printed p. 172); the mechanics text continues onto PDF page 176 (printed p. 173). Transcribed as a single continuous Charm.

name: Luna's Fortitude
summary: Capstone of the Survival and Healing III tree; lets a Lunar ignore all wound penalties entirely for as long as he sustains the Charm each turn, but all deferred wound effects hit at once (potentially fatally) when it ends.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 5; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Will of the Stoic Warrior.
mechanics: By calling on Luna's Fortitude, a Lunar ignores all wounds, period. Any wounds already present remain, and he may sustain new ones, but he suffers no action penalties while the Charm is in effect and is not rendered unconscious (or killed) no matter how far past incapacitated his injuries would take him. A character may sustain use of this Charm for a number of turns equal to his Stamina but must pay for the Charm in each turn. When the Charm ends, all wound effects immediately come into play; if the Lunar has suffered more points of lethal damage than he has health levels (including the health levels below Incapacitated provided by his Stamina), he dies immediately.
compatibility: Duration: One turn. Type: Reflexive.

name: Infection-Resisting Method
summary: Root of the Survival and Healing IV tree; lets a Lunar convert Stamina dice into automatic successes when resisting disease or infection, though it does nothing to cure an existing infection.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 2; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: None.
mechanics: Though diseases and infections are rarely a problem for the Exalted, the harsh lifestyles of the Lunar Exalted expose them to a wide range of contagions, and so, they have learned to use Essence to fortify their metabolisms. When making a roll to resist disease or infection, the Lunar's player may activate this Charm to convert the Lunar's Stamina dice into automatic successes. He may convert as many successes as he has points as the Lunar has of Stamina. The Infection-Resisting Method only helps to avoid disease; it does not resist or to cure disease once the Lunar has become infected.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive.

name: Disease Purging Essence
summary: Lets a Lunar purge his own body of even the foulest plagues and infections by converting Stamina dice into automatic successes on a Stamina + Endurance roll to overcome an infected wound or disease.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Infection-Resisting Method.
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar Exalted can purge his body of even the foulest plagues and infections. When rolling Stamina + Endurance to determine if the Lunar can overcome an infected wound or a disease, the Lunar's player can purchase automatic dice up to the value of the character's Stamina Attribute.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive.

name: Bruise-Relief Technique
summary: Lets a Lunar spend Essence to heal his own bashing damage on the spot, 1 mote per health level per point of Stamina, leaving no scars and usable even while unconscious.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Infection-Resisting Method.
mechanics: The minor contusions represented by bashing damage are of almost negligible concern to a Lunar Exalted, who, by exploiting his shapechanging abilities, can quickly repair bruises, sprains and related injuries. By expending Essence to repair this damage, the Exalt can cause his malleable flesh to repair damage. For every mote spent, the Exalt may remove one health level of bashing damage per point of Stamina, at a cost of 1 mote of Essence per health level. The Lunar does not have to repair all of his lethal damage with this Charm -- he may leave some to heal naturally. To an observer, bruises and other superficial injuries simply fade away to leave unblemished skin. Characters may activate this Charm even if unconscious.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive.
notes: The rate/cost sentence in the source ('For every mote spent, the Exalt may remove one health level of bashing damage per point of Stamina, at a cost of 1 mote of Essence per health level') reads redundantly; paraphrased faithfully as written, but flagged here as possibly reflecting an OCR-adjacent print/layout artifact rather than a genuine rules ambiguity -- worth a second look before promotion.

name: Halting the Scarlet Flow
summary: Lets a Lunar reflexively heal his own lethal damage into bashing damage, 2 motes per health level converted, and automatically close bleeding wounds; works even while unconscious or dying.
requirements: Minimum Stamina 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Bruise-Relief Technique.
mechanics: By exploiting his shapeshifting abilities, a Lunar Exalted is quickly able to deal with cuts and other wounds, causing the flesh around gashes to flow together and broken bones to magically reknit. The Exalt may spend 2 motes to transform a level of lethal damage into bashing damage. In addition, if even one health level is healed, any bleeding wounds automatically close, preventing the loss of further health levels. The Lunar does not have to repair all of his lethal damage with this Charm -- he may leave some to heal naturally. Observers will see the blood flow cease, wounds knit together and swelling subside. Wounds healed with this Charm do not scar. Characters may activate this Charm even if unconscious and dying of mortal injury but cannot activate it if they are actually dead.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive.

name: Lick Wound
summary: Lets a Lunar lick or breathe on an ally's wounds to lend the ally his own Essence and Stamina, boosting the ally's rolls or purchased dice against disease or infection.
requirements: Minimum Wits 2; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Infection-Resisting Method.
mechanics: Using this Charm while licking a subject's wounds or breathing vapors into her face, allows the Lunar to use his own Essence to fortify an ally's resistance to infection. The player may purchase dice up to his character's Stamina and add them to the subject's efforts to resist infection or disease, or her player's rolls to overcome illness or sickness.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Mother's Touch
summary: Capstone of the Survival and Healing IV tree; lets a Lunar heal an ally's bashing and lethal wounds by touch, downgrade lethal to bashing, close bleeding, and even downgrade aggravated damage to lethal at a Willpower cost, up to his Stamina in levels per use.
requirements: Minimum Perception 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Halting the Scarlet Flow, Lick Wound.
mechanics: By infusing his hands with Essence and touching a subject's wounds, a Lunar is able to heal or alleviate those wounds. These healing hands can remove bashing damage and transform lethal wounds into bashing. Mother's Touch also closes bleeding wounds, preventing the loss of additional health levels healed costs 2 motes of Essence, while each level of lethal transformed costs 3 motes. Mother's Touch can be used to transform aggravated damage (into lethal), but each health level removed costs 3 motes and a temporary Willpower point. With each use of Mother's Touch, the Lunar may transform/cure as many levels of damage as he has points of Stamina.
cost: 2 or 3 motes per health level, or 3 motes plus 1 Willpower per health level
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.
notes: Charm's header and opening stat block are on PDF page 176 (printed p. 173); its mechanics text continues onto PDF page 177 (printed p. 174), where the per-health-level cost breakdown is completed. Transcribed as a single continuous Charm.

name: Sense-Sharpening Change
summary: Root of the Perception I tree; heightens all of the Lunar's senses beyond normal humans for a scene, adding bonus dice to Perception rolls up to his Perception dots, though it only enhances mortal senses.
requirements: Minimum Perception 2; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: None.
mechanics: Using this Charm, the Lunar can heighten all of his senses beyond those of normal humans. His ears grow to better hear sound, his nostrils flare to enhance his ability to smell, and his eyes grow and dilate to enhance his sight -- he can even taste individual ingredients in a meal and feel the slightest wind on his skin. For the duration of the Charm, the Lunar's player adds bonus dice equal to the amount of Essence spent to Perception rolls. He may not increase the character's pool by more dice through this Charm than the Lunar has dots of Perception. This enhancement, though powered by Essence, does not grant the character supernatural powers -- it merely enhances his mortal senses.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Heightened (Sense) Method
summary: Actually three separate Charms (sight; hearing and touch; smell and taste) that automatically succeed the Lunar's Perception dice on rolls using the honed sense, purchased and capped separately per sense group.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Sense-Sharpening Change.
mechanics: This Charm is actually three different Charms, one each for sight, for scent and for hearing and touch. Through it, the Lunar can hone his senses far beyond those of most animals. When making a Perception test with the heightened sense, the Lunar's Perception dice are automatically successes, and the Lunar's player need only roll the character's Ability dice (usually Awareness or Survival). Charms that reduce successes in Perception tests affect these automatic successes normally. The Charm must be purchased separately for each of the three sense groups and only provides a bonus when used in conjunction with that sense group. A Lunar may use a maximum of two Heightened (Sense) Charms at any time. If he wishes to enhance a third, he must cease using the Charm on one of the already-heightened senses. Heightened (Sense) Method Charms may not be used at the same time as the Sense-Sharpening Change or any other Charm that boosts the Lunar's Perception, though they may be used in conjunction with sense-enhancing Charms that do not directly enhance the Perception Trait, such as Night Is Day.
compatibility: Duration: 10 turns. Type: Simple.
notes: The Perception II and III tree diagrams (PDF pp. 180-181 / printed pp. 177-178) draw this same Charm as two separate root nodes, 'Heightened Sight Method' and 'Heightened Hearing & Touch Method,' and page 184's Blood-Kin Sense/Perception IV tree references a third label, 'Heightened Smell and Taste Method.' All three are the same underlying three-part Charm described here (one purchase per sense group); no separate rows were created for the aliased tree-diagram labels.

name: Ever-Wary Fox Technique
summary: Lets a Lunar automatically gain a reflexive Perception + Awareness roll to avoid being ambushed if he has sufficient Essence, with bonus dice equal to his Perception.
requirements: Minimum Perception 2; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Sense-Sharpening Change.
mechanics: Lunars are ever aware of their environments and, thus, are very difficult to ambush. When the character is attacked from surprise, the Lunar may choose to activate this Charm automatically if the character has sufficient Essence to power it. When it does activate, the Lunar's player's reflexive Perception + Awareness roll to avoid being ambushed gains a number of bonus dice equal to the Lunar's Perception.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive.

name: Sense-Borrowing Method
summary: Lets a Lunar attach his senses to another human or animal within a mile per point of Essence, seeing entirely through the subject's senses at a +2 difficulty to his own reflexive actions.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Sense-Sharpening Change, Pack-Forming Presence.
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar can attach his senses to those of another human or an animal. The Lunar must touch the target when activating the Charm, but once it is functioning, the target may travel up to a mile from the Lunar per point of the Exalt's permanent Essence and still be a source of sensory information. If the subject is willing, no roll is required to activate the Charm. Otherwise, the Lunar's player must make a Wits + Awareness roll, with a difficulty equal to the target's Essence. Animals of the Lunar's totem species are automatically willing, while others are not unless charmed or befriended. To succeed, the Lunar's player must roll a number of successes equal to or exceeding the target's Essence. Otherwise, the Charm fails, and if the target is a magically aware creature, he knows the Lunar or other supernatural beasts attempted to use a Charm on him. While the Charm is active, the Lunar senses everything his subject does. For all intents and purposes, the subject becomes the Lunar's eyes and ears. The Lunar has some semblance of his own senses, but borrowed senses dominate his perceptions. Any actions taken by the Lunar while the Sense-Borrowing Method is being used -- including reflexive actions -- are at +2 difficulty. As a consequence, most Lunars simply meditate while using the Charm. If either the Lunar or his subject sustain an injury (at least one health level of damage), the Charm ends. This Charm gives the Lunar no control over the creature, he simply shares its senses.
compatibility: Duration: Sustained. Type: Simple.

name: Observed Prey Instinct
summary: Lets a Lunar automatically know when he is being watched by normal senses or magic, with a reflexive Perception + Awareness roll to learn how many observers and where they are.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Ever-Wary Fox Technique.
mechanics: This reflexive Charm allows a Lunar to know if he is being watched, either by normal senses or magic. It activates automatically if the Lunar comes under sustained observation -- a casual glance or a flirtatious look are not enough to trigger it. The Charm guides his perceptions to gather further information, allowing a reflexive Perception + Awareness roll. The number of successes determines the information gathered. A single success merely confirms that the Lunar is being observed, while additional successes will pinpoint the number and direction of observers (one per success). A Lunar observed by magical means will know the viewpoint from which he is being watched but not the actual location of the observer.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Reflexive.

name: Weather-Scenting Method
summary: Lets a Lunar track and predict local weather using Wits + Survival, purchasing knowledge of conditions within a 10-mile radius or of future conditions up to several days out.
requirements: Minimum Wits 2; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Ever-Wary Fox Technique.
mechanics: Lunars with this Charm can track and predict the weather, using Essence to build on and extend their natural perceptions. The number of successes from a Wits + Survival roll determines the scope of information a Lunar can divine. Each success garners him either knowledge of conditions within a 10-mile radius or for the next day (cumulative). A Lunar may purchase information on both area and time, but he must do so in as even a manner as possible. For example, a Lunar who gets 4 successes cannot purchase information on a 40-mile radius for 4 days in advance, but rather learns about a 20-mile radius for two days in advance. If there are an odd number of successes, the Lunar's player may choose which aspect has the additional die. The Weather-Scenting Method may not be used to predict future conditions under the influence of magic, though it may be used to gather information on the prevailing conditions when the Charm is activated.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.
notes: Charm's header and stat block are at the bottom of PDF page 178 (printed p. 175); the mechanics text continues onto PDF page 179 (printed p. 176). Transcribed as a single continuous Charm.

name: Unerring Earth Direction Sense
summary: Lets a Lunar instinctively know the direction of the Imperial Mountain from anywhere, and, with a Wits + Awareness roll, pinpoint his own location with increasing precision.
requirements: Minimum Wits 2; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Ever-Wary Fox Technique.
mechanics: After activating this Charm, the Lunar instinctively knows the direction of the Imperial Mountain. This works irrespective of the Lunar's situation -- it is as effective inside a building or underground as it is in plains or forest -- and works as well in darkness as in daylight. If the Lunar simply desires to know the direction of the Imperial Mountain, no roll is required. However, he may also use this Charm to identify his location, though this requires a Wits + Awareness roll, the number of successes indicating the precision of the information. One success gives him little more than what he already knows, three successes allows him to narrow his location down to the city or district, and five or more let him know precisely where he stands.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Wyld-Sensing Instincts
summary: Lets a Lunar reflexively sense encroaching Wyld warping before it takes hold, giving him and his associates minutes to escape or take shelter depending on how many successes he rolls.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Ever-Wary Fox Technique.
mechanics: Having existed on the edge of the world, Lunar Exalted are ever watchful for the warping effects of the Wyld. Though their nature and their tattoos protect them from its deforming effects, their associates and non-Lunar kin are less fortunate, and their gear is often vulnerable as well. Provided the Lunar has sufficient motes available, Wyld-Sensing Instincts activates reflexively to alert the Lunar when this malign change occurs. Immediately after it does, the Lunar's player must make a (non-reflexive) Perception + Survival roll. The number of successes indicates the amount of time the Lunar has to act before changes occur. One success gives the Lunar a few turns to escape the transformations, while three successes indicates he has several minutes to reach safety. Five or more successes indicates that, while the chaos is not yet approaching dangerous levels, the Lunar has as much as 30 minutes to seek refuge -- or to otherwise protect -- his associates.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Moonsilver-Scenting Sense
summary: Lets a Lunar scent moonsilver deposits or unattuned moonsilver weapons in the region via a Wits + Awareness roll, with more successes revealing distance, quality, and concealment attempts.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Unerring Earth Direction Sense.
mechanics: The Moonsilver-Scenting Sense hones the Lunar's olfactory nerves, allowing her to scent deposits of moonsilver or moonsilver weapons not attuned to a Lunar in the surrounding lands. The Lunar's player must make a Wits + Awareness roll, the number of successes determining what -- if anything -- the character learns of the region. One success allows the Lunar to ascertain whether there is any moonsilver within a number of miles equal to the Lunar's Perception + Essence. Three successes also provide direction and approximate distance. Five or more successes allow the Lunar to judge the quality and condition (e.g., concealed by Dragon-Blooded machinations) of the deposits or items. The Lunar's player may make one roll for every 10 minutes that the Charm is active.
compatibility: Duration: One hour. Type: Simple.

name: Wyld Object Appraisal Method
summary: Lets a Lunar inspect an item touched by the Wyld and determine its original, uncorrupted form and whether it will retain its present form if returned to Creation.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Wyld-Sensing Instincts.
mechanics: Although all Exalted can attempt to discern if something is safe to remove from the Wyld and will retain its form if removed, this ability is far from certain. With the use of this Charm, a Lunar can absolutely tell what the original form of a creation of the Wyld was, whether it will be safe to remove it from Creation and whether or not it will retain its present form when removed. The Lunar can usually inspect only a single item through the use of this Charm, although a number of similar small items could be checked at the same time.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Resisting the Lure of Madness
summary: Lets a Lunar become immune to Wyld addiction for a lunar month; addicted characters do not need to worry about addictive behavior or relapse while it persists but are not cured.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Wyld-Sensing Instincts.
mechanics: A character who activates this Charm is immune to Wyld addiction while the Charm's effects persist. Characters addicted to the Wyld do not have to worry about addictive behavior or relapse while the Charm continues, but those not addicted will not become so while under the magic's sway.
compatibility: Duration: One lunar month. Type: Simple.

name: Harmony With Reality Technique
summary: Lets a Lunar force a piece of Wyld-touched material (up to 50 pounds per point of Essence) to permanently become part of Creation, forcing it to whatever improbable or weird form results, unlike a Solar's ability to shape it as desired.
requirements: Minimum Intelligence 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Wyld Object Appraisal Method, Wondrous Lunar Transformation.
mechanics: A Lunar skilled in the ways of the Wyld can force his will upon it, causing it to accede to his whims. While he cannot create exactly what is desired, as a Solar can, he can force the things he touches to retain their form and function when returned to Creation, no matter how improbable or weird, in essence, he forces that part of the Wyld to become part of Creation. This Charm cannot affect more than 50 pounds of material per point of the character's permanent Essence.
cost: 10 motes plus 1 additional mote per pound of material, 1 Willpower
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Ritual of Lunar Stability
summary: Capstone of the Perception I tree; lets a Lunar mark out a protected area around himself with his scent and presence, reducing local Wyld intensity by a level per three successes for months equal to his permanent Essence.
requirements: Minimum Intelligence 5; Minimum Essence 4; Prerequisite Charms: Harmony With Reality Technique.
mechanics: There are many places on the edges of Creation that are kept safe only through the use of ancient rituals, secret pacts or powerful sorceries. While this Charm cannot replace these powers, it can provide sanctuary from the effects of the Wyld for a time. The use of this Charm requires that the Lunar first pace out the area he wishes to protect, encircling it with her scent and presence; this area can be no larger than a number of square miles equal to her permanent Essence. Once this is done, she sees the Charm, and her player rolls Wits + Lore. For every three successes scored, the level of the Wyld in the protected area is reduced by one (so if she scored six successes, she would reduce an area of Deep Wyld down in intensity to be equivalent to Bordermarches). This effect lasts a number of weeks equal to her permanent Essence.
compatibility: Duration: A number of lunar months equal to permanent Essence. Type: Simple.
notes: The stat block lists Duration as 'a number of lunar months equal to permanent Essence,' but the mechanics text states the area-of-effect reduction 'lasts a number of weeks equal to her permanent Essence' -- transcribed both units faithfully as printed rather than reconciling the discrepancy; worth a second look before promotion.

name: Fish-Eye Technique
summary: Root of the Perception II tree (aliased under the Heightened Sight Method); gives the Lunar 360-degree vision, immune to being caught unawares by visible attacks, at the cost of +1 difficulty to spot fine details.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Heightened (Sense) Method (sight aspect, shown in the tree diagram as 'Heightened Sight Method').
mechanics: By means of this Charm, a Lunar modifies the shape and the nature of his eyes. He gains 360-degree vision and, as a result, is aware of actions all around him and does not suffer penalties for being caught unawares by visible attacks. However, comprehending such a vista forces the Lunar to focus on the 'big picture' rather than the details and, as a result, increases by 1 the difficulty of any Perception rolls involving spotting details.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Night Is Day
summary: Lets a Lunar see perfectly in low-light conditions as though it were daylight, giving up a bit of color vision as a partial trade-off, manifesting as flashing, cat-like eyes.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Heightened (Sense) Method (sight aspect, shown in the tree diagram as 'Heightened Sight Method').
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar alters his eyes to allow him to see perfectly in low-light conditions, though he treats nighttime conditions as daylight, he is partially colorblind (+1 difficulty to Perception rolls in normally lit conditions) for the duration of the Charm. Night Is Day does not allow the Lunar to see in absolute darkness -- there must be some light, even if just a twinkle, for the Lunar's eyes to exploit. The Charm manifests by giving the Lunar flashing, cat-like eyes while it is active.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Perceiving the Hidden World
summary: Capstone of the Perception II tree; lets a Lunar see in perfect darkness by perceiving heat and other light forms invisible to humans, at the cost of +2 difficulty to fine-detail Perception rolls.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Night Is Day.
mechanics: Some animals can see light incomprehensible to humans, most often the spectral glows of heat and cold. Using this Charm, a Lunar can do likewise, allowing him to perceive radiated heat and other forms of light normally beyond his experience. This allows him to see in perfect darkness, though his ability to distinguish detail is greatly impaired (+2 difficulty to all Perception rolls involving fine detail).
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Rabbit Ear Method
summary: Root branch of the Perception III tree (aliased under Heightened Hearing & Touch Method); enlarges the Lunar's ears to track others in his vicinity via a Perception + Awareness roll, with more successes revealing direction, range, and activity.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Heightened (Sense) Method (hearing/touch aspect, shown in the tree diagram as 'Heightened Hearing & Touch Method').
mechanics: Using this Charm -- which, in any form, causes his ears to enlarge and resemble those of a rabbit or stiff-eared dog -- a Lunar can use his enhanced hearing to keep track of others in his immediate vicinity without needing to have them in sight. He is dimly aware of others' presence and may reach with his senses to pinpoint them and gather extra information. Doing so requires a Perception + Awareness roll, difficulty 1 in wilderness conditions, 2 in the streets of a town and 3 inside a structure. One success indicates that the Lunar is aware of those around him, but only in a general sense, while three successes provide him with an approximate direction and range to each. Five or more successes allow provide information on their activities, equipment carried and identities. The Lunar may use this Charm to track a number of others equal to (his Essence x 5) and perceive them out to (his Perception x 100) yards. Unless concealed by Charms, those closest to the Lunar are revealed first, and those furthest from him last. A Storyteller may, at his discretion, identify more distant targets first if they are somehow 'broadcasting' their presence by making lots of noise.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Comprehending Ears Meditation
summary: Lets a Lunar understand any spoken human language or dialect (with increasing fluency at more successes) via a Wits + Linguistics roll, though it grants no ability to speak the tongue or understand nonverbal communication.
requirements: Minimum Wits 2; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Heightened (Sense) Method (hearing/touch aspect, shown in the tree diagram as 'Heightened Hearing & Touch Method').
mechanics: This Charm allows a Lunar to understand -- in general terms if not the exact meaning of words -- any language spoken in his presence. The Lunar's player must roll Wits + Linguistics, with the number of successes indicating the level of comprehension. One success indicates he can get the general gist of what's being said, while three successes afford solid comprehension. Five or more successes allow the Lunar to discern nuances of what has been said, be they insults or flattery. Comprehending Ears Meditation does not allow the Lunar to speak a foreign tongue. Comprehending Ears Meditation does not allow the Lunar to understand nonverbal communication.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Calls of the Human Prey
summary: Lets a Lunar who has eaten a victim's Heart's Blood understand and speak any language or dialect known by that person via a Wits + Linguistics roll, with fluency scaling with successes, though it carries a distinct accent.
requirements: Minimum Wits 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Comprehending Ears Meditation.
mechanics: By activating this Charm, a Lunar can attempt to both understand and speak any language or dialect known by people he has consumed. The Lunar's player makes a Wits + Linguistics roll when the Charm activates. The difficulty is 5 - (the number of people who spoke the language the Lunar has eaten the heart's blood of). The number of successes on the roll determines the Lunar's level of comprehension and fluency. One success indicates linguistic capabilities comparable with a young child, while three successes denote average adult abilities. Five or more successes grant the skills of a poet. Calls of the Human Prey does not allow the Lunar to read or write the language, nor does it make her a perfect mimic. If the Lunar has eaten only a few victims fluent in a single language, his voice may possess a distinct accent that damages his ability to socialize with those who dislike his dialect.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Feral Ears Metamorphosis
summary: Lets a Lunar understand and communicate in general terms with any animal in his presence via a Wits + Linguistics roll, using the same comprehension scale as Comprehending Ears Meditation but for beasts instead of people.
requirements: Minimum Wits 2; Minimum Essence 1; Prerequisite Charms: Comprehending Ears Meditation.
mechanics: This Charm allows a Lunar to understand and communicate with -- in general if not in precise terms -- any animals in his presence. It functions as per the Comprehending Ears Meditation, save with regard to its subjects. The Lunar's player makes a Wits + Linguistics roll when the Lunar activates the Charm, with a difficulty of 5 - (the number of beasts of that species the Lunar has eaten the heart's blood of). The Lunar need only get one success in most cases, as valid animals are not generally articulate. However, if the animal is a complex thinker normally unable to communicate, then more successes may be relevant. A Lunar using this Charm can automatically understand the language of his totem animal form (no roll needed).
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Seeing Without Looking
summary: Capstone of the Perception III tree; lets a Lunar build a detailed mental picture of his surroundings by echoic hearing alone over five turns, letting him fight and identify hidden things while functionally blind.
requirements: Minimum Perception 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Rabbit Ear Method.
mechanics: By focusing his hearing, a Lunar can build a mental picture of the surrounding area. Unlike the Rabbit Ear Method, which only tracks individuals, Seeing Without Looking also allows the Lunar to build up an idea of the objects and materials that make up the environs by analyzing subtle alterations in the sound of echoes. Analyzing the sounds he hears takes the Lunar five turns, during which time he may move about at a walking pace but cannot take any other actions. If he does, the Charm fails. After five turns have elapsed, the Exalt's player makes a Perception + Awareness roll. The number of successes on this roll determines the quality and the range to which the sense applies. One success indicates that the Lunar has a general picture of the surroundings, including the position of people, beasts and major obstacles. However, he knows little about their composition and size and cannot tell the difference between two small objects placed close together. Three successes let the Lunar refine his search, allowing him to identify the materials and giving him a finer 'resolution' in his sense. Five or more successes allow the Lunar to identify most details in his immediate area, save those that can only be gleaned by sight (such as color). With five successes, the Lunar can also identify hidden people and items in the vicinity, even if Charms were used as part of the concealment process. The Lunar's mental picture extends a number of yards equal to (the number of successes on the Perception roll x 5). Provided he maintains the Charm and carries out no actions other than walking, the mental image remains constant. However, as soon as he carries out any action or ceases to spend Essence, the picture 'locks' though the Lunar may still act on the details for the remainder of the scene. Thus, a Lunar who wishes to fight blind will need to use this Charm to build up a picture of his surroundings and Rabbit Ear Method to sense his foes. However, such a Lunar might be deceived by sliding walls, silently opening pits or other changes that make the static picture of his environment obsolete.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Blood-Kin Sense
summary: Root branch of the Perception IV tree (aliased under Heightened Smell and Taste Method); lets a Lunar sense blood ties between individuals via a Perception + Awareness roll, with more successes revealing lineage details, especially potent if the Lunar tastes the target's blood.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Heightened (Sense) Method (smell/taste aspect, shown in the tree diagram as 'Heightened Smell and Taste Method').
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar can immediately sense the blood ties between other individuals. A Lunar's player may make a Perception + Awareness roll when the character targets the Blood-Kin Sense on an individual. If the player gets at least one success, the Lunar knows if the person is related to someone else the Lunar is familiar with, while three successes give some indication of the relationship. Five or more allow the Lunar to sense firm details of the subject's lineage, including a capsule history of the being's ancestor's physical abilities for a number of generations back equal to the Lunar's Essence. The Blood-Kin Sense assumes the Lunar is using scent to study his subject. If the Lunar tastes the target's blood, his player gains three bonus dice for the roll.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.
notes: Charm's header and stat block are at the bottom of PDF page 183 (printed p. 180); the mechanics text continues onto PDF page 184 (printed p. 181). Transcribed as a single continuous Charm.

name: Blood on the Wind
summary: Lets a Lunar track a person or animal across almost any terrain by scent via a Perception + Survival roll, needing only one success to follow mundane prey and gaining automatic tracking successes against other supernatural trackers while in beastman form.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Heightened (Sense) Method (smell/taste aspect, shown in the tree diagram as 'Heightened Smell and Taste Method').
mechanics: By means of the Charm, a Lunar can track an opponent (or opponents) through almost any terrain. To the Lunar, the trail is as clear on solid stone as it is in the woodlands or on soft ground. When making a tracking roll (Perception + Survival) for the character, her player need roll only a single success for the character to follow his mundane prey. Furthermore, if the Lunar is in beastman form when using this Charm, he is considered to be a supernatural tracker and has a number of automatic successes in the tracking contest against other supernatural trackers equal to his Essence.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple.

name: Emotion-Revealing Scent
summary: Lets a Lunar sense a target's true emotional state by scent even through a calm facade, requiring no roll for a basic impression but a Perception + Investigation roll for deeper insight into the cause.
requirements: Minimum Perception 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Heightened (Sense) Method (smell/taste aspect, shown in the tree diagram as 'Heightened Smell and Taste Method').
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar can sense the emotional state of her subject, even if there are no outward signs. Even if the target appears perfectly calm, his body scent will betray him, allowing the Lunar to clearly scent strong emotions such as fear, anger, hate and love. Doing this does not require a dice roll, though it does count as a dice action. The Charm does not, automatically divine the cause of this emotion or its focus. To divine a deeper understanding of the target, the Lunar's player must roll Perception + Investigation, the number of successes indicating the degree of information gathered. One success merely confirms the initial impression, while three successes denote the source, target or object causing the emotions. Five or more successes allow the Lunar to deduce the reason for the emotion.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Truth-Scenting Method
summary: Capstone of the Perception IV tree; lets a Lunar detect lies by scent, targeted or ambient, though it only detects outright falsehoods (not evasions) and judges truth by the speaker's own belief, not objective fact.
requirements: Minimum Perception 4; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Emotion-Revealing Scent.
mechanics: By observing subtle physical and chemical responses in his subject, a Lunar can determine whether a person in his presence is speaking the truth -- in which case, he may target the Charm at an individual -- in which case it works more automatically -- or he may use it more generally on a body of people. In this latter case, the Lunar's player must roll Perception + Investigation, the number of successes being the number of people the Exalt can successfully observe. The Truth-Scenting Method does not detect evasions or statements that twist the truth without actually being falsehoods. Furthermore, some 'truths' are subjective, and it is the target's view, not that of the perceiving Lunar, which determines this. For Example: if a subject says, 'I saw him do it,' when he saw no such thing, the Lunar can detect the lie. However, the Charm will not detect a lie if the subject states, 'No, Janek didn't pay me anything' (because Marcos did), as it is an evasion, not an outright lie.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Stealthy Fox Method
summary: Root of the Stealth tree; lets a Lunar call on feral instincts to add bonus dice, up to his Dexterity, to any Stealth roll for the rest of the scene.
requirements: Minimum Dexterity 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar can call on his feral instincts to enhance any attempts to hide or use stealth. By honing both his senses and his agility, the Lunar exploits all cover to the maximum possible extent, avoiding obstacles that might alert others to his presence, and moves in such a graceful manner as to avoid catching the attention of unwary observers. For the rest of the scene, when making a roll to move stealthily or to hide, the Lunar's player may add bonus dice up to the character's dots of Dexterity, at a cost of 2 motes per die.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Chameleon Skin Disguise
summary: Lets a Lunar mimic chameleon skin to convert dice up to his Dexterity into automatic successes on Stealth rolls while holding still, paying upkeep motes to re-adapt his camouflage whenever he moves.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Stealthy Fox Method.
mechanics: Using this Charm, a Lunar can mimic the skin of the chameleon and becomes able to adjust the texture and color of his hide to better aid in concealment. For the rest of the scene, as long as the character stays still, he may convert a number of dice up to his Dexterity Attribute into automatic successes on a Stealth roll, at a cost of 2 motes per dot of Dexterity converted. If the character moves any distance, the Lunar must reflexively spend 2 motes at the end of the movement to adapt the camouflage to his new background; the Charm's benefits are negated until the character pays these 2 motes. The Chameleon Skin Disguise provides the Lunar with no advantage if he is clothed or armored.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.
notes: The mechanics text opens with a sentence that reads almost identically to the following sentence describing the dice-to-successes conversion, which may be a printing redundancy in the original; paraphrased here as a single coherent rule rather than duplicated. Worth a second look before promotion.

name: Object-Concealing Method
summary: Lets a Lunar find or create a hiding place for an item via Wits + Survival, with the roll's successes setting the difficulty for anyone deliberately searching for it afterward.
requirements: Minimum Wits 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Chameleon Skin Disguise.
mechanics: The Object-Concealing Method allows a Lunar both to find a suitable place of concealment for an item and to enhance its protection against a deliberate search. The Lunar's player rolls Wits + Survival, difficulty 1 (higher in terrain that offers few hiding places), searching an area out to (his Wits x 10) yards. If he succeeds, the Lunar has found a place of concealment for the item, and the number of successes becomes the difficulty for others' Perception + Investigation rolls to find the object in a deliberate search; the object cannot be discovered by accident. It takes (10 minus the Lunar's Essence) turns to hide the item.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple.
notes: Charm's header and stat block are at the bottom of PDF page 185 (printed p. 182); the mechanics text continues onto PDF page 186 (printed p. 183). Transcribed as a single continuous Charm.

name: Ally Concealing Method
summary: Extends the Object-Concealing Method to hide other characters instead of items, at a cost per person concealed, though the Lunar cannot use it to hide himself and it breaks if the hidden ally attacks.
requirements: Minimum Wits 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Object-Concealing Method.
mechanics: This Charm functions as per the Object-Concealing Method, save that the thing being hidden is another character rather than an item. The concealing effect remains active so long as the affected character stays calm and relatively still; attacking will disrupt the camouflage. A Lunar may conceal as many people at once as his Essence Trait, at a cost of 5 motes each. A Lunar cannot use Ally Concealing Method to hide himself. It takes (10 minus the Lunar's Essence) turns to find a place of concealment for each individual.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Traceless Passage Technique
summary: Lets a Lunar erase all signs of his passage and resting places for a day, blocking mundane trackers entirely and imposing a difficulty penalty equal to his Essence on magically aided trackers (except other Lunars).
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Stealthy Fox Method.
mechanics: Lunars are crafty in the ways of the wild, adept at following -- or hiding -- signs of passage. There are times, however, when a Lunar wishes to truly disappear, throwing even the craftiest pursuers off the scent. Traceless Passage Technique allows him to do so, concealing evidence of his passage and disguising anywhere he rested. Trackers without magical enhancements are unable to follow his trail while the Charm is active, and those with Charms or sorcery to aid their tracking suffer a difficulty modifier equal to the Lunar's Essence. Traceless Passage Technique does not provide any automatic successes against other Lunars attempting to track him.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple.

name: Track-Sweeping Essence
summary: Capstone of the Stealth tree; extends the Traceless Passage Technique's trail-concealing benefits to the Lunar's companions, at a mote cost per person covered (including the Lunar himself, if desired).
requirements: Minimum Charisma 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Traceless Passage Technique.
mechanics: Using this Charm, the Lunar can extend the benefits of Traceless Passage Technique to his companions, and his instincts help to guide their actions as well as his own. Enacting the Charm costs 4 motes, and each person encompassed in Track-Sweeping Essence costs an additional 2 motes; if the Lunar wants to conceal his own passage as well, he must pay for himself. The Lunar can conceal the passage of as many people as he has points of Essence.
compatibility: Duration: One day. Type: Simple.

name: Tale-Spinning Mastery
summary: Root of the Interaction and Knowledge I tree; lets a Lunar storyteller add bonus dice (up to his Charisma) to any storytelling roll while addressing an audience of five or more people per extra mote spent.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: None.
mechanics: Lunar society has little in the way of a written tradition, instead preferring to pass information down orally, often through stories. A master storyteller knows how to use Essence and his shapeshifting powers to enhance the tale, adjusting his voice and actions to suit the audience. Normally the Charm affects five subjects, but for each additional mote spent the speaker can increase his audience by five more people (a Lunar with sufficient Essence can address a crowd this way, though it is an inefficient method). While the Charm is in effect, the Lunar's player can add bonus dice to any test involving storytelling, though the bonus may not exceed the character's Charisma. The Storyteller may increase the difficulty of the roll if the audience is hostile, disinclined to listen, or otherwise distracted, and the audience must be able to comprehend the Lunar's speech for the Charm to work.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Lore-Speaking Method
summary: Lets a Lunar enter a meditative trance to search his memories for lore or historical knowledge via Intelligence + Wits, extending the trance's duration to dig deeper into recollection.
requirements: Minimum Intelligence 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Tale-Spinning Mastery.
mechanics: Most Moons do not believe in writing; their history, traditions and knowledge are conveyed orally. By using Lore-Speaking Method, a Lunar can enter a meditative trance and search his memories for relevant information. The trance lasts a minimum of 30 minutes, though it may be extended if he wishes, providing the Lunar's player with additional time to search: at the end of the meditation, the Lunar's player makes an Intelligence + Wits roll, adding a bonus die for each additional 10 minutes the character spent in meditation, to a maximum bonus of his Intelligence. The difficulty depends on the nature of the information sought -- 1 for routine matters, 3 for more obscure lore, and 5 for esoteric knowledge the No Moons may have mentioned only in passing -- and the net successes determine the strength and clarity of the recollection. The Storyteller may keep the exact difficulty secret, instead telling the Lunar how sure he is of the memory. If the Lunar's player rolls no successes, or if the Exalt is interrupted before 30 minutes have elapsed, the Charm fails.
compatibility: Duration: 30 minutes plus 10 minutes per die. Type: Simple.

name: Divining the Hidden Truth
summary: Lets a Lunar undertake a Wyld-touched vision quest to seek knowledge beyond his ken via Perception + Lore, risking disorientation, bashing damage, or worse on a poor or botched roll.
requirements: Minimum Perception 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Lore-Speaking Method.
mechanics: Sometimes a Lunar has need of information he does not know. In routine matters, he can turn to the No Moons, who may be able to provide what he needs in return for a boon, but some information can only be acquired from outside sources. A civilized Lunar might trek into the Threshold or even the Realm proper in his quest for knowledge; those with closer ties to the Wyld instead seek knowledge from their ancestors and friendly spirits by means of a vision quest, entering a deep trance and letting his mind and spirit wander free -- perhaps aided by psychotropic fungi or the crushed essence of certain beetles -- with no guarantee of success, and no easy way to distinguish real insight from mere imagination. At the end of the quest, which lasts a number of hours equal to the Lunar's Essence, his player may ask a single question and roll Perception + Lore, at a difficulty depending on the nature of the information sought -- routine information requires only a single success, hidden knowledge obscured deliberately or otherwise requires at least three successes, and even five successes may not suffice for the deepest secrets. The Lunar may not count more successes than his permanent Essence Trait and must discard any extras. Failing the roll can have devastating effects: if the Lunar gets at least one success but not enough to succeed, he simply wakes none the wiser, but failure leaves the Lunar disoriented and forced to soak a number of dice of bashing damage equal to his Essence, while a botch leaves him catatonic for a number of days equal to his Essence and may also result in a derangement.
compatibility: Duration: 1 hour or more. Type: Simple.

name: Lion Roar Method
summary: Lets a Lunar transform his voice into a deafening roar audible for a long distance, usable as a pseudo-weapon against a nearby target that costs the target a point of Perception on a failed resistance roll.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Tale-Spinning Mastery.
mechanics: Using this Charm to expand his lungs and vocal cords, a Lunar can transform his normal voice into a formidable roar. Anything the Lunar says while the Charm is in effect is clearly audible to anyone within a number of yards equal to (the Lunar's Essence x 100) and to those with acute hearing for twice that distance. A Lunar can also use the Lion Roar Method as a pseudo-weapon by roaring at an individual within 10 yards; that individual must make a reflexive Stamina + Endurance roll at a difficulty equal to the Lunar's Perception. If the target fails, he temporarily loses a point of Perception and must attempt to resist further exposure at a worsened difficulty for the remainder of the scene.
compatibility: Duration: Indefinite. Type: Simple.
notes: The mechanics text describing the exact consequence of a failed resistance roll is cut off mid-sentence at the bottom of PDF page 188 (printed p. 185) by a full-width illustration, and the following page continues a different Charm (Wind-Speaking Method) rather than resuming this sentence; the ending clause here is a faithful best-effort paraphrase of the visible fragment ('he temporarily loses a point of Perception and must attempt...'), not a verified complete rule. Worth a second look if the exact resolution matters before promotion.

name: Wind-Speaking Method
summary: Lets a Lunar whisper a short message on the wind to a known recipient at range, with more successes on a Wits + Linguistics roll reducing delivery time and extending range.
requirements: Minimum Wits 3; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Lion Roar Method.
mechanics: Winds circulate around the world, and while not as skilled as the Dragon-Blooded at manipulating the elements, some Lunars do know how to call upon the wind and use it to convey messages to their allies. Upon activating this Charm, the Lunar whispers a few words (his Essence score x 5 in words maximum) and names a recipient. The Exalt's player then rolls Wits + Linguistics; the difficulty of the roll depends on the range to the intended recipient -- difficulty 1 if within 1,000 yards, two successes required for up to a mile, and three or more successes to reach up to five miles. The recipient must be known to the Lunar and must have spoken to him at some point in the past. The target is the only person to hear the message -- sending messages to multiple recipients requires multiple invocations of the Charm. There may be a delay in delivery depending on the range; it takes one hour for the message to cross 600 miles. The Storyteller may require a Wits + Performance roll to determine the clarity of the message at its destination.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: River of Words
summary: Capstone of the Interaction and Knowledge I tree; a more powerful Wind-Speaking Method with no range limit, longer and multi-recipient messages, and a much larger maximum audience.
requirements: Minimum Wits 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Wind-Speaking Method.
mechanics: A more powerful version of the Wind-Speaking Method, River of Words allows messages that are more complex, longer distance and multiple recipients. There is no range limitation to the message transmission, though there may be a delay in delivery dependent on the range; it takes one hour for the message to travel up to 600 miles. The maximum number of recipients for a River of Words communiqué is equal to the Lunar's Essence, and the maximum number of words each message may contain is (the Lunar's Essence x 10).
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Emotion-Shaping Technique
summary: Root of the Interaction and Knowledge II tree; lets a Lunar subtly raise or lower one of a target's Virtues (never above 5 or below 1, and never past a 2-dot swing) via successes on a Manipulation + Presence roll.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 3; Minimum Essence 2; Prerequisite Charms: Tale-Spinning Mastery.
mechanics: The Emotion Shaping Technique enhances a Lunar's already considerable presence, using a combination of charisma, insight and timing to allow the Exalt to manipulate the emotional responses of his audience. The target must be capable of understanding the Exalt for the Charm to function correctly but need not be paying full attention to what is being said; the Lunar's words and the Charm work on the subconscious mind as much as on the conscious mind. The Lunar's player rolls Manipulation + Presence, and each success allows the Lunar to temporarily increase or decrease one of the target's Virtues by a point. This may not raise the Virtue above 5, nor lower it below 1 (even under the influence of this Charm, a paragon of valor will not become a sniveling coward), and a Virtue may not be altered by more than two -- even across two uses of the Charm. Two successes could be applied one each to two Virtues or two to one Virtue of one character and one to one Virtue of another. However, other Charms such as the Crowd-Inciting Method and Courage-Building Address are better able to manipulate the Virtues of large numbers of people; this Charm does not work on spirits of any sort.
compatibility: Duration: One scene. Type: Simple.

name: Crowd-Inciting Method
summary: Extends the Emotion-Shaping Technique to lower the Temperance or Compassion of a whole crowd via Manipulation + Performance, at a difficulty that scales with crowd size.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Emotion-Shaping Technique.
mechanics: In broad terms, the Crowd-Inciting Method follows the same principles as the Emotion-Shaping Technique but is better suited to influence large numbers of people, albeit in a restricted manner. The Lunar must be heard by the crowd, and his player rolls Manipulation + Performance against a difficulty dependent on the size of the crowd (+1 per 50 people or fraction thereof). If the roll succeeds, the player may spend Essence to temporarily reduce the Temperance or Compassion Virtue of the crowd to a maximum of 2 dots and not below 0 (meaning that if the Exalt has more than four successes, some are wasted, perhaps making it more amenable to suggestions). A failed roll has no effect, but a botch may result in the crowd turning on the speaker.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Crowd-Calming Pronouncement
summary: Mirror-image of the Crowd-Inciting Method that instead temporarily raises a crowd's Compassion or Temperance (up to 5), at a higher base cost and difficulty.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Crowd-Inciting Method.
mechanics: The Crowd-Calming Pronouncement functions in the same manner as the Crowd-Inciting Method, save that it allows the Lunar to temporarily increase the Compassion or Temperance of the crowd by up to 2 dots (but not above 5). The base Essence cost is higher than the Crowd-Inciting Method, and the difficulty is +1 per 30 people in the crowd -- it is harder for the Lunar to calm a mob than to stir one into action. A failed roll has no effect, but a botch may result in the Lunar turning on the speaker.
compatibility: Duration: Instant. Type: Simple.

name: Courage-Building Address
summary: Lets a Lunar deliver an inspirational pre-battle speech that temporarily raises troops' Valor via a Manipulation + Performance roll, scaling with the size of the addressed force.
requirements: Minimum Manipulation 4; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Crowd-Calming Pronouncement.
mechanics: In battle, numbers are rarely the deciding factor. Instead, troop quality is often the key, and courage is the cornerstone of that quality. By means of the Courage-Building Address, a Lunar can instill a sense of bravery in his troops, increasing their Valor Virtue for the duration of the battle (requiring at least four minutes) by means of an inspirational speech. While the Lunar makes the speech, his player must make a Manipulation + Performance roll (difficulty 2 if the target is the unit commander or another notable individual, 3 otherwise). For every two successes gained, the troops' Valor temporarily increases by a dot for the duration of the battle. A failed roll has no effect, but a botch may harm the resolve of the troops. The Courage-Building Address cannot be recast during a battle.
compatibility: Duration: One battle. Type: Simple.

name: Glorious Battle Presence
summary: Capstone of the Compassion/social branch; lets a Lunar's battlefield commands carry clearly over a wide radius, grants bonus dice to leadership rolls, and immunizes his own troops to fear and intimidation effects.
requirements: Minimum Charisma 5; Minimum Essence 3; Prerequisite Charms: Courage-Building Address.
mechanics: Lunars are adept at combat, and they excel on the battlefield -- they are a fearsome sight and inspirational to an enemy and to their own allies. By means of this Charm, a Lunar can influence the performance of his troops in a battle. His commands are clearly audible to troops within (his Essence x 100) yards, and his player gains a bonus die equal to the character's Charisma when attempting any rolls involving leadership. Furthermore, any friendly troops within (the Lunar's Essence x 10) yards are immune to any effects that would reduce their Willpower or Valor and cannot fail Valor checks. Any enemy troops within the same radius are subject to an increase of 1 to the difficulty of resisting intimidation or demoralization.
compatibility: Duration: 3 turns. Type: Supplemental/Special.

name: Foe-Taunting Utterance
